about: sha256 of each sample city's city_model.json (citygen build output). The same bytes on every machine with the pinned requirements: produced on the cloud machine (x86_64 Linux), confirmed with GEOS rebuilt against libc++ (the C++ library of macOS builds) and under emulated aarch64 Linux (same pins); traces of every stage are in docs/progress/M1b_det/ (M1b) and docs/progress/M2/<city>/trace.json (M2). tests/test_roads.py asserts them on every run.
